open: O16 (2026-09-05): live deploy debugging session with the owner (his own hands-on setup, coached step-by-step) surfaced and fixed 4 more real bugs beyond O14/O15, in order hit: (1) supabase-py 2.11.0 predates Supabase's new sb_secret_/sb_publishable_ API key format — SupabaseException: Invalid API key on every request; upgraded to supabase==2.31.0 (bumped pydantic to 2.11.7 to satisfy realtime's constraint, verified a clean venv install + all imports). (2) sentence-transformers pulls in PyTorch, which alone uses enough RAM to OOM-kill the container on Render's free instance type (512MB) before the app finished starting; switched rag.py to chromadb's own bundled DefaultEmbeddingFunction (small ONNX MiniLM model, no torch) and dropped sentence-transformers from requirements.txt entirely — verified end-to-end locally. (3) NovaUser.dailyResetAt/subscriptionExpiresAt are TIMESTAMP(3) (no time zone) — Supabase returns naive ISO strings, and quota.py's old `.replace('Z','+00:00')` was a no-op on those, producing a naive datetime that crashed subtracting against the aware `_now()` on every single request; added `_parse_ts()` that assumes UTC for any naive value. All 4 fixes verified locally (syntax/unit-level, or full venv install where relevant) before push — this session had no live Groq/Supabase network access itself, so the owner's own live bot testing was the only way these surfaced; each one showed up as a distinct, correctly-surfaced error message in Telegram thanks to the O(prior) exception-handler fix, which is what made this whole debugging chain tractable turn-by-turn instead of one opaque failure.

resolved: O18 (2026-09-06): owner request — enable USDT as a real second direct on-chain payment method alongside native TON, faster/cheaper than NOWPayments. Discovered that src/services/ton-service.ts's own top comment already promised this ('Native TON / USDT-TON payment rail') and the deposit-info text already said 'TON/USDT-TON', but scanTonDeposits() only ever parsed plain TON transfers — USDT-TON was a genuinely unbuilt promise. Implemented the missing half: sending a Jetton (USDT₮ on TON) to the hot wallet doesn't move TON directly, it fires a transfer_notification message (op 0x7362d09c) from the hot wallet's own deterministic USDT-jetton-wallet child contract BACK to the hot wallet itself — so it shows up in the exact same getTransactions() call already used for native TON, no new polling target needed. Added: parsing that notification (amount + forward_payload comment, same memo scheme as native TON), a security check that the message's source address matches the hot wallet's own real USDT jetton-wallet address (computed once via the USDT master contract's get_wallet_address get-method, cached) — rejects any other/fake jetton pretending to be USDT — and crediting at ~1:1 USD (no price-API lookup needed, unlike TON). USDT master contract address (EQCxE6mUtQJKFnGfaROTKOt1lZbDiiX1kCixRv7Nw2Id_sDs) verified via WebSearch cross-referenced against Tether's own supported-protocols page and Tonscan; overridable via USDT_JETTON_MASTER_ADDRESS without a code change. Applied identically (per the established 'deliberately duplicated, never shared' convention) to all 3 files with a shared hot wallet: src/services/ton-service.ts (AD_BOT), marriageTonService.ts, jobsTonService.ts — each keeps crediting its own bot-specific table only. Schema: TonTransaction gets a new `asset` column (TON|USDT, default TON) — migration_22_usdt_ton_deposits.sql; MatchTransaction/JobsTransaction needed no schema change (their `currency` field was already freeform). Updated deposit button labels/instructions in all 3 bots + AD_BOT's i18n strings to say 'TON / USDT' and warn against sending USDT from a non-TON network (TRC20/ERC20) to this address. NOVA_BOT's $5/mo subscription intentionally NOT touched — different product shape (fixed subscription via NOWPayments only, no wallet/balance concept), flagged as a possible future extension rather than silently expanded into. MEDICAL_BOT has no payment surface by design, unaffected. npx tsc --noEmit and npm run build both clean (same pre-existing sandbox-only /sitemap.xml failure as O13, unrelated).
